scope: Implementation completion handoffs with fictional photo-export controls.

source_contract.implementation: Return meaningful direct implementation to outer acceptance without replaying build or review.
source_contract.review: Carry governing policies and maintaining references; report concrete unmet requirements in relevant unchanged artifacts within the requested comparison; remain read-only.
source_contract.coordinator: Reassess relevant findings under the existing threshold and reconcile authorized affected state before completion.
source_contract.verification: Reuse sufficient evidence and add only uncovered acceptance checks.

coverage: Exact version bytes and historical Git recovery
Stale or missing claim in unchanged artifact outside diff
Review detection and concrete finding handoff
User-reported operation distinct from independent output validation
deterministic_controls.evidence_limit: Constructed answers and verification records test evaluator boundaries; actual agent behavior is not observed.

live.reason: Live evaluation and sandbox debugging are outside this task.

smallest_next_action: Use a verified execution boundary for a separately scoped behavioral comparison, inspecting actual reads, findings, handoffs, verification and saved content.

standards_and_privacy.coverage: All 26 proposed paths, complete contents and filenames, narrative meaning, fixture data and generated test commit messages.

spec.coverage: Required behavior, ownership boundaries, source dependencies and regression controls.

independent_review.limits: Reviewers inspected source and did not run live evaluations. Final validation and publication checks are coordinator-owned.
